_doc: Corpus gate ceilings — per-client defect-rate ceilings enforced by the
corpus-gate-scanner. Populated at stage 8, set by MEASUREMENT of the
current corpus, never by aspiration (Implementation Plan, stage 8).
CI Gate B (scripts/gate_b_ceiling_ratchet.py) fails any commit that RAISES
a ceiling relative to the base commit. Ceilings only ratchet down.
